title: Adoption of MOOCs in Saudi Arabia for Health Administration and Informatics Education: Application of Self-Determination Theory and Media Richness to Behavioral and Actual Use
reason: PLS-SEM/CB-SEM survey of 145 faculty and students on MOOC adoption (self-determination needs, media richness, intention, 'actual use'). All constructs, including actual use, are seven-point Likert self-report items; no platform data.

extraction.n_quote: sampling was used, and data were collected from 145 respondents, including faculty
extraction.population: faculty members and students in health administration/informatics
extraction.outcome_or_construct: behavioural intention and actual use of MOOCs (self-report)
